QuestInfo.name: Positive Energy
QuestInfo.0: In search of someone to fill a glass bottle with warm, positive energy! Yes, really!

yes.0: #p9310556# has a request. Carry this #i3996055##t3996055# close to your heart and fill it with positive energy. Trust me, even if you FEEL like your soul is being drained into the bottle, you'll be okay. Have fun!

no.0: You're not quite ready for a quest like this...

0.msg: Hey, you filled the bottle. That was quick! And your're still alive. What a relief!

yes.0: I'll give you your reward, then. Nice work.
